schemes.name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
schemes.description: Income support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments of ₹2,000 directly to bank accounts of cultivable landholding farmer families.
schemes.eligibility: All landholding farmer families having cultivable landholding in their names.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
schemes.description: Comprehensive crop insurance scheme providing financial support to farmers suffering crop loss/damage arising out of natural calamities, pests & diseases.
schemes.benefits: Max premium: 2% for Kharif crops, 1.5% for Rabi crops, 5% for commercial/horticultural crops. Balance paid by Govt.
schemes.eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas including sharecroppers and tenant farmers.

schemes.name: Soil Health Card Scheme
schemes.description: Provides soil health cards to farmers with crop-wise nutrient recommendations to improve productivity through balanced use of fertilizers.
schemes.benefits: Free soil testing card every 2 years indicating 12 soil health parameters (N, P, K, pH, EC, etc.) and dosage advice.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY - Per Drop More Crop)
schemes.name_hi: प्रधानमंत्री कृषि सिंचाई योजना (प्रति बूंद अधिक फसल)
schemes.description: Promotes micro-irrigation technologies (drip and sprinkler systems) to save water and enhance water-use efficiency.
schemes.benefits: Up to 55% subsidy for small & marginal farmers and up to 45% for other farmers on micro-irrigation equipment.
schemes.eligibility: All categories of farmers having cultivable land with assured water source.

schemes.name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
schemes.description: Timely access to affordable short-term credit for crop cultivation, post-harvest expenses, and farm asset maintenance.
schemes.benefits: Concessional interest rate of 4% per annum (with prompt repayment incentive). Credit limit based on land & crops.
schemes.eligibility: All farmers, sharecroppers, tenant farmers, self-help groups of farmers.
